purpose: Public review of already-sealed causal diagnosis only

manual_review.reports: All conclusions, hypotheses, adverse observations, failures, timing overhead and schema limitation preserved; local-path strings aliased. Historical status statements unchanged.
manual_review.traces: Complete R1/R2 trace records and actual native commands retained, including captured DOM/state payloads. Data are synthetic ux-workspace/ux-project fixtures. No cookie/localStorage/profile export present.
manual_review.source: Only relevant exact frontend snapshots, tests and frozen build text; source is evidence, not canonical implementation publication.
manual_review.infrastructure: Unrelated listeners/host environment, private Memory/Skill bodies, indexes/ref inventories and predecessor archives omitted; task-loopback ports retained for event provenance.
manual_review.provenance: BYTE_EXACT versus REDACTED and UTF-8 lossless chunk identities explicit. No arbitrary truncation or rewritten failure.
manual_review.sufficiency: Causal review material complete for stated scope. Independent re-verification of full repository preservation or all predecessor qualification cases not claimed.

secret_scan.scope: all proposed public UTF-8 files including reports/helpers/traces/source/metadata
secret_scan.limitations: Heuristic pattern scan plus explicit content-category review; not a guarantee of absence of all possible secrets.

publication_permission: Owner explicitly authorized public evidence subset and verified source snapshots; no product repository write.
